svg.title: Instances solved within a time limit, MCC 2020–2026 track 1, saved logic-circuit compilation, 120 s
svg.desc: Cactus plot: for each solver, the number of instances solved (vertical) within a time (horizontal, linear, up to 120 s). tididi-cnf solves 700; Panini solves 578; D4 (compiler) solves 487; GPMC (compiler) solves 482; c2d solves 387.
